title: Creed
subtitle: Stay your blade from the flesh of an innocent. Hide in plain sight, be one with the crowd.

trails.title: Beneath the Cathedral
trails.description: It is only natural for an unknown creature to be kept in the basement of the Cathedral.

items.text: Blood.
Some say Florence is a land baptized in glory and blood.
So much blood has been spilled here. By the Romans and the Saints. The Guelphs and Ghibellines. The Medici and the Pazzi.
And those who fought for freedom.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: *pant*

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: Give it up, Assassin! The whole city is looking for you! You won't get away this time!

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: Our orders are clear! Secure the relics and the golden apple, and one equally important command from the Pope himself—

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: Kill the Assassin Ezio Auditore.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We will help you open the secret chamber.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Vertin, we can't just—wait, when did you figure out how to open the secret chamber?
Alberto offers a satisfied clap.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Well, well. It's time you shared your little secret.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Vertin ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Everything will be alright. Now, let's pay attention to the fresco.
Her calm tone is a mask worn over a swirling pool of anxiety.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Can you recall the riddle?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Of course. It's how we got this far.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Under the waning glow, the waning sanctuaries unite.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Leonardo proposed that these "waning sanctuaries" must refer to vanishing points. And by "unite," he means the place these vanishing points connect.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Hmm ...

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: So we need to find where they are connected? What does the other half of the sentence mean then? "Under the waning glow" ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Could it be that the optical filter—I suppose that's me—must be placed at their intersection at dusk?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I believe so.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Well done, my obedient lambs. You've cracked the puzzle quite nicely.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Now what follows is just some tedious work from my side.
Released from the priest's censer, wisps of fog stretch and encroach, inch by inch, within the small enclosed space.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: This APPLe feels light and dizzy ... Are we in heaven now?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's that sleeping gas again! Hold your breath!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: H-Hold my ...?
Time seems to have stopped moving.
The air is filled with heavy doses of scopolamine and atropine. They alter colors, twist lines, and disregard all physical laws effortlessly.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: *yawn* ... As above, so below ... as below, so above ...

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Fool, do you think I'd give you the chance to buy time for your friends?
The priest's figure tilts and bends in their vision, only his lips seem to remain in place.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: We will bring order to this chaotic world. By straying from order, you invite your own doom—you are bound to fail.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: *pant*

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Hmm?
The sharp, clear cry of an eagle snaps the Timekeeper back to awareness.
The priest paces over to the stained glass window; at first he looks anxious, but then he appears to relax.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: My memory is as poor as ever. It's nearly dusk, and our assassin is most assuredly dead—

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Ugh!
Dust-covered stained glass and blood spray intertwine into a breathtaking arc of light.
The priest kneels in the sunset light, staring up at his own death reflected in his killer's eyes.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Ezio ...? How ...?
A faint metallic scent lingers in the air, blood and dust staining the Assassin's grayish robe.
He arrives just in time.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: You claim to bring order, but all you do is seek control.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Fortunately, neither the world nor its people will bow so easily.
The few defeat the many in this battle.
The priest lies on the ground, his pale, aging face distorted by a rippling pool of blood.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: *cough* Ezio ... You pestering bastard dog ...

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: An assassin never loses track of his target.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: How did you ... survive ...?

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: You're outnumbered, Assassin. There's no way you can survive this.

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: It's better that you kneel and accept your fate. No one can withstand the Order.
The doors and windows on the street have all been tightly shut.
The bustle on the street has disappeared. Even the wind falls silent, anticipating the worst.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Heh. Outnumbered? Where did you get that idea?
Shadows emerge from behind him flanking him on either side.

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: *gasp*

items.speaker: Templar VI
items.text: Where did they ...?!
Leaping down from rooftops, sneaking in from the alleys, the phantoms swiftly gather behind Ezio.
The wordless determination in their eyes speaks for them.
We work in the dark, to serve the light.
We are Assassins.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: All those "lowlifes" you so readily dismissed—when I needed them, they came to our aid.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: I-Impossible ...
One knee on the ground, the Assassin stares at the priest's trembling eyes, writhing in pain.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Buy every soldier and summon every knight and every Templar in this city—it will never be enough.
The Assassin's hidden blade is driven through the priest's heart.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: No ... *cough* It can't ... end like this ... *cough*
But as it seems like the priest should breathe his last, he begins to laugh.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Heh heh ... assassins, you're merely puppets on a string; driven by delusion.

items.speaker: Alberto
items.text: Each life you take ... brings you one step closer to the darkness ...

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Let it be so.
Entering the darkness is not a curse for us; it is our most solemn duty.
An assassin does not fear the darkness any more than an eagle would fear the sky.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Faith should bring comfort, not pain.
He closes the fallen priest's eyes with undue reverence.

items.speaker: Ezio
items.text: Rest in peace.
